title: Recording tickets: what to note and why

videos.script: A technician fixes a problem and moves on to the next one. A month later the same problem comes back, on another computer, to another technician. {{month}} Whether it takes five minutes or an afternoon depends on one thing: what was written down the first time. {{written}} This lesson is about the ticket as a record: which facts go in it, how to collect them from a computer in one paste, and what a ticket looks like when the next person can use it. {{record}} And about the words that do not belong in it. {{words}}
